# Electric Power Steering Pump Install

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Install an electric power steering pump with custom hydraulic hoses and wiring. [t1144]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Measure the length of the existing belt using a piece of rope as a baseline.
2. Order an A/C pulley designed for a non-SC Xterra.
3. [Partial] Purchase a new ribbed belt sized at 34 inches in length.
4. Visit an auto parts store to inspect their stock room and find a compatible pulley with extra ribs.
5. [Partial] Select a second belt measuring exactly 33.75 inches long from the same order.
6. Slide the selected A/C pulley onto the power steering shaft until it fits perfectly.
7. Mount the new ribbed belt over the pulleys and crank the engine to apply proper tension.
8. Verify there is sufficient clearance between the top of the belt and the coolant hose.
9. Install the electric pump into its designated mounting location in front of the radiator.
10. Take measurements for a custom hydraulic hose needed to connect the new pump system.
11. [Partial] Visit a local hydraulic shop with the banjo bolt from the truck and an adapter from the pump.
12. Consult another specialized steering component shop after receiving no clear solution at the first stop.
13. Allow the specialist to cut off the valve end of the removed fitting and weld it into shape as a custom adapter.
14. [Partial] Have the shop bore out the new adapter slightly before cutting a 24-inch hose to order for you.
15. [Partial] Connect the red wire from the battery's front post directly to the pump's power input terminal.
16. Attach the tan ground wire from the battery's front post to the pump's corresponding ground terminal.
17. [Partial] Plug the connector into the harness containing a 12v ignition source with black and blue/white wires.
18. Tie both the black and blue/white wires together at the connector to create an ignition switch function.

_Procedure reported by [t1144]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-00-04-xterra-p-s-bypass-electric-p-s-install.8466/>_
